mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.8% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor sentiment toward risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.8% for 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a near-term recession and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5%, the market prices in a high-cost environment that suppresses corporate profitability and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the joint signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption (RSAFS) following two consecutive months of decline signals a recovery in consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases after two consecutive monthly declines
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive after RSAFS rebounds, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate, signals strong labor market momentum that supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 7.0%, or the joint signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters, as measured by the latest available data, indicates a recessionary environment that triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 shows negative growth in two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is negative for two quarters, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
